risk_note: RV1 (packages/bridge-sdk, apps/h5 conformance entry). Token manager hardening after the F1-01b second review: requests in flight across invalidate() never send with the old token and re-obtain; getH5Token results are validated (bad shape -> 90500, not cached); event data filtered by the contract whitelist (conformance subpath keeps a raw onRaw, used by the conformance page); a 10002 replay is bound to the token generation of the first send (account switch during the refresh returns the first 10002 unchanged). Rule tests by Codex (red first in the container), implementation by Opus 5.5 (three rounds) and one Codex handover round. Written by hand.

reviews.scope: fresh read-only Claude subagent after the Codex handover (规划/11 §2.5): the S1 (replay with another account's token after an account switch during the 10002 refresh) is fixed for POST and GET, before / during / after the refresh, refresh success or 90401; same-account replay, read_only re-obtain and retry caps intact; S2 isDateTime accepts second 60 at any time (needs a malformed native expire_at), noted as follow-up

reviews.note: S1: a read_only token re-obtained after invalidate() was dropped by the old-generation check; S2 microtask race before send; fixed in Opus round 3

reviews.scope: read-only Claude subagent on Opus round 3: pass; S2 account switch during the 10002 refresh could replay with the new account's token (later Codex S1, fixed by the handover)

reviews.note: S1: account switch during the 10002 refresh replays the old write request with the new account's token; fixed by the Codex handover round

spec_test_review.note: RV1: the rule-test review is required for RV2 only (规划/11 §2.3 step 3)

longrun.note: PROP_RUNS=1000000 PROP_SEED=20261001; packages/money and test/properties are unchanged from main

handover.note: Opus used its three implementation rounds; the remaining Codex general-review S1 (cross-account 10002 replay) was fixed by one Codex handover round (规划/11 §2.5, RV1 task paths): the replay is bound to the first send's token generation
